title: Do Reasoning Models Break the Hivemind? Testing Diversity Under Chain-of-Thought

original_idea.body:
# Do Reasoning Models Break the Hivemind? Testing Diversity Under Chain-of-Thought

**Problem:** Success state: we know whether 'thinking' models reduce or amplify inter-model homogeneity, so we can predict whether the shift to reasoning models changes systemic-correlation risk. Backward: the Artificial Hivemind study covered standard LLMs; the reasoning-model case is an open follow-up explicitly flagged in the subfield notes.

**Direction:** On a slice of Infinity-Chat-style open-ended queries, compare output homogeneity between non-reasoning and reasoning variants of open models (e.g., Qwen base vs. Qwen reasoning, DeepSeek-R1-distill vs. base). Measure intra-model repetition and inter-model similarity with and without extended CoT. Test whether reasoning increases convergence (shared reasoning templates) or divergence.

**Why it matters:** Reasoning models are becoming the default. If chain-of-thought makes models converge even harder onto shared reasoning paths, the homogeneity risk worsens precisely as deployment scales — important for forecasting medium-horizon systemic risk.

**Relevant context:** Direct follow-up flagged in subfield Recent Surprising Results ('study homogeneity in reasoning models'). Open reasoning models run on a single consumer GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (reasoning models change systemic homogeneity) but the path to catastrophic-risk reduction is somewhat indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: compare reasoning vs non-reasoning variants on homogeneity metrics; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (reasoning-vs-base homogeneity comparison) with few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open reasoning models, inference-only; weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Reasoning-model inference (longer outputs) on open models; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Explicitly flagged open follow-up; homogeneity in reasoning models may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Flagged open follow-up; reasoning-model homogeneity partially open.
